project_type: Pure Python CLI application, no web framework, no external LLM API required
build_system: No build system. All modules are plain Python files under lcc_system/src/. Run directly with `python`.
test_framework: pytest 7.4+. Run with: python -m pytest tests/ -v  (from lcc_system/ directory)
verification_instructions: 1. cd to lcc_system/ directory. 2. pip install -r requirements.txt (installs pytest only). 3. python -m pytest tests/ -v — all tests must pass. 4. python demo.py — must print ≥4 conversation turns, ≥1 [DECISION] line, and final state summary, exit 0.
snapshot_or_generated_files: lcc_system/data/synthetic_cases.json — generated at runtime by DatasetLoader.generate_synthetic_cases(), NOT checked in. Do not commit it.
environment_constraints: NEVER modify files under dailymed_corpus_final/, rxnorm_capstone/, DDXPlus_Audit_Share_Package/, or MedPRESS_Audit/. Keep all raw datasets read-only. Python stdlib only — no new packages beyond pytest. No API keys hardcoded anywhere.
contribution_requirements: All source under lcc_system/src/. All tests under lcc_system/tests/. requirements.txt lists only pytest. README.md must have exact setup+run commands. No fabricated data. No training a new LLM.
key_patterns: All inter-module data flows through dataclasses defined in models.py. DatasetLoader is the single point of file I/O for external datasets. Every module that needs data takes a DatasetLoader instance (or pre-loaded lists) in __init__. Error handling: missing files → log warning to stderr, return empty list, never raise. Python stdlib only (json, csv, re, dataclasses, datetime, pathlib, os, sys, argparse, copy, hashlib, time, collections, urllib.request).
directory_structure: lcc_system/ is the Python project root. lcc_system/src/ holds all modules. lcc_system/tests/ holds pytest files. lcc_system/data/ is a runtime-generated scratch dir (not committed). lcc_system/demo.py is the CLI entry point. Raw data lives in sibling directories: dailymed_corpus_final/, rxnorm_capstone/, DDXPlus_Audit_Share_Package/ — all read-only.

confirmed_data_facts.ddxplus_note: No release_*_patients CSVs exist in workspace. All DDXPlus cases must be generated synthetically using hard-coded templates matching the confirmed schema.
